body: Source correction for KP-1.66: Dimitroglou Rizell–Golovko already provide mutually exact-Lagrangian-concordant stabilized knots with distinct smooth knot types, disproving antisymmetry. Includes the unchanged frozen source audit and separate passing source-match review. Classification: already_solved, 0/5 new proof attempts; queue update coordinated separately. The cited paper is accepted with assigned October 2026 issue details. This audit does not independently certify all h-principle dependencies, supply a smallest stabilization count, or claim novelty or human peer review. Changes are confined to attempts/2725.
